rationale: The workflow already implements the key evidence-supported optimization: a Gradle dependency cache (actions/cache) covering ~/.gradle/caches and ~/.gradle/wrapper with a key derived from Gradle files, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated by the pattern's own condition "An equivalent cache already exists." The only other fitting pattern, P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout), has its precondition met (representative successful-duration history exists: five recorded runs all succeeded in roughly 1.5–2.5 minutes), but there is no evidence of runaway or slow valid runs in this repository, and adding a timeout would not shorten successful runs while risking failure on cold/slow runs. No remaining pattern fits a single-job workflow without weakening coverage or introducing unrelated changes.
